Bus seven assigned to the Sector Four evacuation.

Sector Four residents arriving now. Receiving evacuees at Alpha.

Visibility below operational minimum in Sector Four. Aircraft access looks bad.
Generator three assigned to Shelter Alpha.

Generator three is on the way to Alpha.
